judged_text: Dead fallback breaks Google Calendar update/delete for bookings without `externalCalendarId` (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:~256` in `updateEvent` and `~314–316` in `deleteEvent`): in the else branch `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` can never match and the expression always yields `undefined`, unlike the previous fallback to `event.destinationCalendar.externalId`; updates/deletes for pre-refactor bookings and no-credentialId-path bookings issue API calls with an undefined `calendarId` and fail, stranding or duplicating calendar events.

record.issue_text: Dead fallback breaks Google Calendar update/delete for bookings without `externalCalendarId` (`packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:~256` in `updateEvent` and `~314–316` in `deleteEvent`): in the else branch `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` can never match and the expression always yields `undefined`, unlike the previous fallback to `event.destinationCalendar.externalId`; updates/deletes for pre-refactor bookings and no-credentialId-path bookings issue API calls with an undefined `calendarId` and fail, stranding or duplicating calendar events.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` change the fallback calendar selection to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. If `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, this `find` predicate can’t match any normal destination calendar (its `externalId` will be a real string), so the expression almost always returns `undefined`. This is a regression from the previous fallback (`event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and can lead to calling Google APIs without a valid calendar id (or at least failing to target the intended destination calendar) for cases where `externalCalendarId` isn’t present.
